_about: The editor's own text. Change the text after each colon, keep every {name} as it is (the editor fills it in), then rebuild with npm run build.
alpha.backup: It is early work and can still get things wrong. Do not trust it with a map you have no backup of: copy the map before you open it here.
alpha.closeFirst: Close the map in World Editor first, and do not change it from anywhere else (World Editor, another tool, a script) while it is open here: the editor saves its own view of the map over the files.
